'''Alexander Davidovich Dilman''' ({{langx|ru|Алекса́ндр Дави́дович Ди́льман}}<!--provide citation for birthdate-->) is a Russian [[Organic chemistry|organic]] chemist and is a professor of [[Russian Academy of Sciences|the Russian Academy of Sciences]]. Dilman is currently a Head of the Laboratory of Functional Organic Compounds at [[N. D. Zelinsky Institute of Organic Chemistry|N. D. Zelinsky Institute of Organic Chemistry of the Russian Academy of Sciences]] (ZIOC RAS). Since 2022, he is a Corresponding Member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences|Russian Academy of Sciences.]]

== Biography ==
Dilman was born in [[Moscow]] in 1976. At the age of 15, he attended the Moscow Chemical Lyceum in order to dive deeper into chemistry. In 1993, Dilman attended the [[Higher Chemical College of the Russian Academy of Sciences]]. During his undergraduate research he studied the chemistry of nitro- and [[Organosilicon chemistry|organosilicon compounds]]<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Dilman |first1=A. D. |last2=Lyapkalo |first2=I. M. |last3=Belyakov |first3=P. A. |last4=Ioffe |first4=S. L. |last5=Strelenko |first5=Yu. A. |last6=Tartakovsky |first6=V. A. |date=2000 |title=N,N-Bis(tert-butyldimethylsilyloxy)aminobenzene as a new synthetic equivalent of nitrosobenzene |url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/BF02495178 |journal=Russian Chemical Bulletin |language=en |volume=49 |issue=9 |pages=1649–1650 |doi=10.1007/BF02495178 |issn=1066-5285|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Dilman |first1=A. D. |last2=Tishkov |first2=A. A. |last3=Lyapkalo |first3=I. M. |last4=Ioffe |first4=S. L. |last5=Strelenko |first5=Yu A. |last6=Tartakovsky |first6=V. A. |date=1998 |title=Novel Convenient Method for the Synthesis of N,N-Bis(trimethylsilyloxy)enamines |url=https://www.thieme-connect.de/products/ejournals/abstract/10.1055/s-1998-2019 |journal=Synthesis |language=en |volume=1998 |issue=2 |pages=181–185 |doi=10.1055/s-1998-2019 |issn=0039-7881|url-access=subscription }}</ref> at the ZIOC RAS under the supervision of Vladimir Tartakovsky.

Dilman completed an internship in the group of {{Interlanguage link|Herbert Mayr (chemist)|lt=Prof. Herbert Mayr|de|Herbert Mayr (Chemiker)}} at [[LMU Munich]] in 2000. The results he obtained in Germany became a part of his dissertation. In 2001, he defended his Ph.D. thesis on the topic "Chemistry of N,N-bis([[silyloxy]])enamines" under the supervision of Prof. Sema Ioffe.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Дильман |first=Александр |date=2001 |title=Химия N, N-бис(силилокси)енаминов |trans-title=Chemistry of N,N-bis(silyloxy)enamines |url=https://www.dissercat.com/content/khimiya-n-n-bissililoksienaminov |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120427052857/http://www.dissercat.com/content/khimiya-n-n-bissililoksienaminov |archive-date=2012-04-27 |place=Moscow}}</ref> During a post-doctoral internship in [[Henri B. Kagan|Prof. Henri Kagan]]'s laboratory Dilman studied the chemistry of [[rhodium]] and [[iridium]] [[Transition metal carbene complex|carbene complexes]] in 2002.

Dilman began to work in the field of [[organofluorine chemistry]] at ZIOC RAS in 2003.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Dilman |first1=Alexander D. |last2=Tishkov |first2=Alexander A. |last3=Lyapkalo |first3=Il'ya M. |last4=Ioffe |first4=Sema L. |last5=Kachala |first5=Vadim V. |last6=Strelenko |first6=Yury A. |last7=Tartakovsky |first7=Vladimir A. |date=2000 |title=Synthesis of N,N-bis(silyloxy)enamines with a functionalized double bond |url=https://xlink.rsc.org/?DOI=b004268o |journal=Journal of the Chemical Society, Perkin Transactions 1 |issue=17 |pages=2926–2929 |doi=10.1039/b004268o|url-access=subscription }}</ref> In 2008, he defended his Dr. Sci. dissertation connected with the development of new methods for the synthesis of fluorinated amines.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Дильман |first=Александр |date=2008 |title=Новая методология синтетического использования силанов, содержащих перфторированную группу |trans-title=A new methodology for the synthetic use of silanes containing perfluorinated group |url=https://www.dissercat.com/content/novaya-metodologiya-sinteticheskogo-ispolzovaniya-silanov-soderzhashchikh-perftorirovannuyu- |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180730153113/http://www.dissercat.com/content/novaya-metodologiya-sinteticheskogo-ispolzovaniya-silanov-soderzhashchikh-perftorirovannuyu- |archive-date=2018-07-30}}</ref> In 2011 Dilman became the head of the Laboratory of Functional Organic Compounds at ZIOC RAS.{{Citation needed|date=November 2024}}

Recently [[photoredox catalysis]] became the main research area of the Dilman group. Utilising visible light energy in chemical reactions allows many procedures to be more environmentally-friendly and widely available to organic chemists. == Teaching ==
Since 2003, Dilman, together with William Smith has taught the course "Organic Synthesis" at ZIOC RAS. In 2009, he continued to lecture on this discipline together with his student V. V. Levin. A book based on the course, co-authored with W. A. Smith, was published in 2008.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Смит |first1=Вильям |title=Основы современного органического синтеза |last2=Дильман |first2=Александр |date=2009 |publisher=Издательство "Бином" |isbn=978-5-93208-434-2 |edition=7th |location=Москва |publication-date=2024 |language=ru |trans-title=Essentials of modern organic synthesis}}</ref>
